rv.q: Musical adaptation of the Cliff Richard film beams simple sunshine
All the cast perform energetically, but somehow the wisecracks are never sharp enough to cover up the nonsensical plot.
Summer Holiday is a blissful adventure with a charming ensemble cast whose soaring vocals and strong musicianship are on strong display.
This show is all about the joy of the music and every song is a delight.

cn.t: Critics find this feel-good adaptation delivers infectious energy and talented performances, though some question whether the 1963 film's wholesome period charm translates effectively to today's stage.
